description: This is a Java unit test class for the ProgramWorkflowService class in the OpenMRS project. It contains test methods that verify the behavior of program workflow management functionalities, including retrieval, validation, and cascading delete operations. The tests use Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit 5 for structuring the tests.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceUnitTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ProgramWorkflowService, testing various scenarios including program retrieval, validation, and cascading delete safeguards.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the ProgramWorkflowService instance before each test.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldCallDaoGetProgramsByName
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO method is called with the correct parameters when retrieving a program by name.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldReturnNullWhenThereIsNoProgramForGivenName
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when no program matches the provided name.

methods.name: getProgramByName_shouldFailWhenTwoProgramsFoundWithSameName
methods.description: Ensures that an exception is thrown if multiple programs with the same name are found.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests that saving a program without a concept results in an exception.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the program's workflow lacks a concept.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateConceptIsNull
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if a workflow state lacks a concept.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateInitialIsNull
methods.description: Checks for exception when a workflow state is not marked as initial.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldFailIfProgramWorkFlowStateTerminalIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that a workflow state must be marked as terminal correctly.

methods.name: savePatientProgram_shouldFailForNullPatient
methods.description: Ensures validation prevents saving a patient program without a patient.

methods.name: savePatientProgram_shouldFailForNullProgram
methods.description: Ensures validation prevents saving a patient program without a program.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram_shouldFailGivenNonEmptyStatesAndTrueCascade
methods.description: Tests that cascade-delete is not supported if patient states exist.

methods.name: purgeProgram_shouldFailGivenNonEmptyWorkFlowsAndTrueCascade
methods.description: Tests that cascade-delete is prevented when a program has workflows.
